import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Analyze yellowtail catches by season day and trip class
trips = tables['trips']

# Group by class and fished_date_doy to see seasonal patterns
yt_by_doy = trips.groupby(['cls', 'fished_date_doy']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'landing': 'count'
}).reset_index()
yt_by_doy.columns = ['cls', 'doy', 'total_yt', 'total_anglers', 'num_trips']
yt_by_doy['avg_yt_per_trip'] = yt_by_doy['total_yt'] / yt_by_doy['num_trips']

# Calculate average share per angler
yt_by_doy['yt_per_angler'] = yt_by_doy['total_yt'] / yt_by_doy['total_anglers']

# Price per trip class
prices = {
    'hd_am': 80, 'hd_pm': 80, 'hd_unspecified': 80,
    'hd_twilight': 80, 'three_quarter': 150,
    'full_day': 275, 'overnight': 400, 'day_1_5': 550
}

yt_by_doy['price'] = yt_by_doy['cls'].map(prices)
yt_by_doy['yt_per_dollar'] = yt_by_doy['total_yt'] / (yt_by_doy['price'] * yt_by_doy['num_trips'])

# Sort by season day to see temporal patterns
result = yt_by_doy.sort_values('doy')[['cls', 'doy', 'avg_yt_per_trip', 'yt_per_angler', 'yt_per_dollar', 'num_trips']]
print("Yellowtail by day of year and trip class (sorted by DOY):")
print(result.head(50))
print("\n--- Best average yt per trip by class ---")
print(yt_by_doy.groupby('cls')[['avg_yt_per_trip', 'yt_per_dollar']].mean().sort_values('yt_per_dollar', ascending=False))

import pandas as pd

# Look at seasonal patterns - when is yellowtail season strongest?
trips = tables['trips']

# Group by DOY range to see broader seasonal patterns
trips['doy_range'] = (trips['fished_date_doy'] // 15) * 15  # Group by 15-day periods

seasonal = trips.groupby('doy_range').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'mean', 'std'],
    'landing': 'count'
}).reset_index()
seasonal.columns = ['doy_range', 'total_yt', 'mean_yt_per_trip', 'std_yt', 'num_trips']

# Filter to only fishing days
seasonal = seasonal[seasonal['num_trips'] > 0].sort_values('doy_range')
print("Seasonal pattern (15-day buckets, DOY):")
print(seasonal[['doy_range', 'mean_yt_per_trip', 'total_yt', 'num_trips']].to_string())

# Also look at pier temperature correlation
pier = tables['pier']
ocean = tables['ocean']

# Get average water temp by DOY
pier_temp = pier.groupby('ts_doy').agg({'wtmp_c': 'mean'}).reset_index()
pier_temp.columns = ['doy', 'avg_temp_c']
pier_temp['avg_temp_f'] = pier_temp['avg_temp_c'] * 9/5 + 32

# Merge with trip data
trips_temp = trips.groupby('fished_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'landing': 'count'
}).reset_index()
trips_temp.columns = ['doy', 'total_yt', 'num_trips']
trips_temp['yt_per_trip'] = trips_temp['total_yt'] / trips_temp['num_trips']

merged = trips_temp.merge(pier_temp, on='doy', how='left')
merged = merged[merged['num_trips'] >= 2].sort_values('avg_temp_f')
